cost.envelope_method: 0.1805 * (512/272) * (256/64), conservatively scaling whole geometry-check time with both length and vocabulary; speculative, not a measured bound.
cost.measured_anchor: Synthetic double CPU 272-token whole mechanics row: stable native 0.0779-0.0811 seconds, geometry 0.1420-0.1804, nanoGPT prefix-check row 0.0827-0.1023. These include verification work and are not language throughput measurements.
cost.prelaunch_requirement: Authorize and measure 20 full-shape FP32 updates per arm plus selection/confirmation cost first; revise cost and obtain budget approval if above cap. No such profiling launched here.
cost.storage: Propose 100 MiB for this tiny pilot including data/manifests/checkpoints; verify actual bytes and free space first.

data.encoding: raw bytes 0..255; no learned tokenizer; no teacher
data.partition_rule: Before execution freeze source digest, document IDs and disjoint train/selection/confirmation document manifests, auditing overlap with all historical data. Reserve at least 131072 target bytes each for selection and confirmation. Freeze exact packing/reset semantics before any scoring.
data.source: Proposed new licensed document corpus; exact source/version and availability unresolved; no corpus opened in this task

design.matching: Geometry arms exactly equal count. nanoGPT approximately parameter-matched within 1 percent, not FLOP/walltime matched. This does not establish a frontier against strong modern positional baselines.

nanogpt.count_status: Analytical only; instantiate and verify before approval execution

evaluation.confirmation: Freeze selected config and checkpoint hashes for all 12 arm-seed pairs, then evaluate reserved confirmation twice in FP32; preserve every seed.
evaluation.primary_history: 512-byte episode with matching context availability, state reset between episodes
evaluation.statistical_scope: n=3 has low power; report all deltas and uncertainty. One primary contrast, other comparisons descriptive. No claim of independence across byte windows.

futility_rule: Stop on source/fidelity failure, nonfinite loss, incomplete data bindings, exhausted approved CPU budget, or any unpreservable run. Preserve failed arms; no automatic LR replacement or extra seeds.
hypothesis: Conditioned oriented fast-state rotation reduces reserved byte CE relative to equal-count alignment-dot rotation, rather than merely benefiting from added trainable flexibility.

one_b_planning.cost_formula: USD per arm-seed = measured hours * current approved device-hour price + storage/data/evaluation/checkpoint overhead; no provider quote obtained because cloud access is prohibited. Three seeds and two arms multiply base hours by six, before tuning.
launch_blocks: pinned strong positional and recurrent baselines
measured recurrent/teacher compute and peak memory
actual provider quote and explicit user resource budget

primary_metric: mean paired reserved byte cross-entropy difference: oriented minus alignment, nats per byte
success_rule: All three paired deltas negative, mean delta <= -0.01 nats/byte, paired t 95% CI upper endpoint below 0; also beat native on all paired seeds. Otherwise inconclusive or failed, never retune on confirmation.

training.boundary_masks: Bind corpus packing so each update contains exactly 512 valid targets; no cross-document targets. All arms use paired seed schedules.
training.carry_ablation: Unbounded carry and a separate reset-state ablation deferred; no free extra history in primary comparison.
training.hierarchy_state: Adjacent 256-byte chunks within a 512-byte episode share state, detached at the midpoint. Reset at episode and true document/split boundaries; never across train/selection/confirmation.
training.nanoGPT_history: Train and evaluate at 512, same inputs and target masks; no untrained-position extrapolation.
training.objective: scratch byte CE, identical valid-target normalization
training.selection: Evaluate updates 250,500,750,1000 on selection only; choose minimum CE across exactly two LRs and four checkpoints per arm/seed; earlier update then lower LR resolves ties.
